note: calculateTinetti(data) returns { tinettiTotal, balanceScore, gaitScore, tinettiCategoryLabel, firedRules } — no flags — so this is a SPLIT engine: the oracle pins detectAdditionalFlags(state) as expected.additionalFlags with flagsArgs ["state"], mirroring form-app.js's `detectAdditionalFlags(state)` (form-app.js renames tinettiCategoryLabel to tinettiCategory for display; the oracle stores the grader's own key). Scoring: 9 balance items (max 16) + 8 gait items whose catalogue maxScores sum to only 10 (1+1+1+1+1+2+2+1), not the 12 the header comment and the FLAG-GAIT-001 '/12' message claim — so a perfect form scores 26/28 and totals 27-28 are unreachable (BUG: the published POMA gait scores step length and step height separately for each foot; this port has one item each); null items contribute 0; firedRules lists only items scored > 0 (a 0 or null item is simply absent), in balance-then-gait catalogue order (BAL-01..09, GAIT-01..08). Category: >= 25 'Low fall risk', >= 19 'Moderate fall risk', else 'High fall risk' — a blank form therefore scores 0 = High fall risk and fires FLAG-FALLRISK-001 + FLAG-DEVICE-001 (QUIRK). Flags verified: FLAG-FALLRISK-001 total <= 18; FLAG-RECURRENT-001 fallsLastYear >= 2; FLAG-TUG-001 timeSeconds > 14 (14.0 exactly does NOT fire); FLAG-BALANCE-001 balance <= 10 with at least one balance item answered; FLAG-GAIT-001 gait <= 8 likewise; FLAG-POLYPHARM-001 medications.length >= 5; FLAG-SEDATING-001 fires for ANY non-empty fallRiskMedications list — the sedating-class keyword test (`hasSedating || length > 0`) is a dead predicate (QUIRK); FLAG-FEAR-001 fearOfFalling === 'severe'; FLAG-INJURY-001 fires on ANY non-empty injuriesFromFalls text, so an explicit negative like 'None' fires it (QUIRK); FLAG-ROM-001 any 'severely-limited' ROM field; FLAG-DEVICE-001 total <= 18 AND currentDevices empty; FLAG-DEVICEFIT-001 deviceFitAdequate === 'no'. Flags are stable-sorted high > medium > low in insertion order. Regenerate expected with: bin/test-personas mobility-assessment --update

personas.name: Low fall risk - full marks after hip replacement rehab
personas.description: 72-year-old woman six months post left total hip replacement, discharged from physiotherapy: every Tinetti item at its catalogue maximum (balance 16; gait only reaches 10 in this port because step length and step height are single 0-1 items, so the engine's ceiling is 26 not 28), TUG 8.5 s, no falls in the last year, two medications, no fall-risk medications, no fear of falling, ROM normal throughout, no assistive device. Expect tinettiTotal 26, balanceScore 16, gaitScore 10, tinettiCategoryLabel 'Low fall risk', all 17 items in firedRules (BAL-01..BAL-09 then GAIT-01..GAIT-08), and an empty additionalFlags array.

rangeOfMotion.notes: Full functional range on the operated side.

firedRules.description: Sitting balance (0 = leans or slides, 1 = steady/safe)
Rises from chair (0 = unable without help, 1 = able using arms, 2 = able without arms)
Attempting to rise (0 = unable without help, 1 = able but requires >1 attempt, 2 = able on first attempt)
Immediate standing balance (first 5 seconds) (0 = unsteady, 1 = steady with walker/cane, 2 = steady without aid)
Standing balance (0 = unsteady, 1 = steady with wide stance or uses support, 2 = narrow stance without support)
Nudged (eyes open, feet together, examiner pushes on sternum x3) (0 = begins to fall, 1 = staggers/grabs, 2 = steady)
Eyes closed (same position as above) (0 = unsteady, 1 = steady)
Turning 360 degrees (0 = discontinuous steps, 1 = continuous steps) (0 = unsteady, 1 = steady)
Sitting down (0 = unsafe, 1 = uses arms or not smooth, 2 = safe/smooth)
Initiation of gait (0 = any hesitancy or multiple attempts, 1 = no hesitancy)
Step length (right foot passes left stance foot) (0 = does not pass, 1 = passes)
Step height (right foot clears floor) (0 = does not clear, 1 = clears)
Step symmetry (0 = right and left step lengths unequal, 1 = equal)
Step continuity (0 = stopping or discontinuity between steps, 1 = continuous)
Path (observed over 10 feet) (0 = marked deviation, 1 = mild/moderate deviation or uses aid, 2 = straight without aid)
Trunk (0 = marked sway or uses aid, 1 = no sway but flexion of knees/back or arms spread, 2 = no sway, flexion, or arm spread)
Walking stance (0 = heels apart, 1 = heels almost touching while walking)

personas.name: Moderate fall risk at the 19-point boundary with explicit-negative injury text
personas.description: 79-year-old man with Parkinson's disease: balance items sum to exactly 10 (nudged balance left unanswered, i.e. null and skipped), gait items sum to 9 (step symmetry scored 0), total 19 — the lowest 'Moderate fall risk' score. TUG exactly 14.0 s (threshold is > 14, so no TUG flag); one fall last year (< 2, no recurrent flag); injuriesFromFalls recorded as the explicit negative 'None'; four medications, no fall-risk medications; fear of falling moderate; hip extension moderately limited; uses a single-point stick with adequate fit. Expect tinettiTotal 19, balanceScore 10, gaitScore 9, 'Moderate fall risk', 15 firedRules (BAL-06 absent because null, GAIT-04 absent because 0), and two medium flags in order: FLAG-BALANCE-001 ('Balance subscore 10/16') and FLAG-INJURY-001 ('Previous injuries from falls: None' — the explicit-negative quirk). No FALLRISK, TUG, GAIT (9 > 8), POLYPHARM, SEDATING, FEAR, ROM, DEVICE or DEVICEFIT flags.

personas.name: High fall risk with recurrent injurious falls and no device
personas.description: 86-year-old woman with vascular dementia and osteoporosis: balance 4 (sitting, rises, attempting, standing scored 1; the rest 0), gait 3 (step length, path, trunk scored 1; the rest 0), total 7; TUG 32 s; four falls in the last year with a Colles fracture and scalp laceration; seven medications including zopiclone and codeine listed as fall-risk medications; severe fear of falling; hip flexion and ankle extension severely limited; no assistive device in use. Expect tinettiTotal 7, balanceScore 4, gaitScore 3, 'High fall risk', 7 firedRules (BAL-01, BAL-02, BAL-03, BAL-05, GAIT-02, GAIT-06, GAIT-07), and eleven flags: high tier in order FLAG-FALLRISK-001 ('7/28'), FLAG-RECURRENT-001 ('4 falls'), FLAG-TUG-001 ('32s'), FLAG-DEVICE-001; medium tier in order FLAG-BALANCE-001 ('4/16'), FLAG-GAIT-001 ('3/12'), FLAG-POLYPHARM-001 ('7 medications'), FLAG-SEDATING-001 (lists both medicines), FLAG-FEAR-001, FLAG-INJURY-001, FLAG-ROM-001 ('Hip flexion, Ankle extension'). FLAG-DEVICEFIT-001 cannot fire (no device to be ill-fitting).
